component.name: flatpark-spawn
component.summary: Lets an app run the host's command-line tools

description.p: Shared by the apps that declare it. An app that holds the org.freedesktop.Flatpak permission runs the commands its tools call (git, node, gh, the user's own scripts) on the host, in the user's login-shell PATH, as if they were installed in the sandbox. This runs outside the sandbox on purpose; an app without that permission is not affected.

An optional configuration file on the host, ~/.config/flatpark-spawn/config.yaml, sets where commands are looked up (the login shell's PATH, extra and excluded directories) and lists shims: commands made available in every app's PATH, for programs that look for a command on disk or run without the preload library, such as VS Code's extension host. flatpark-spawn check reports problems with the file.
An absolute path such as /usr/bin/nvim that the app does not have now runs on the host. Starting a command from a multithreaded process no longer risks a deadlock in the child.
